name: stirlingpicks
description: - Clone the repository https://github.com/47hamza/nodejs-server-template.git - Run command `npm init` to initialize the project and create package.json file. - Run command `npm install -g nodemon yarn` to install nodemon and yarn globally. - Run command `yarn add bcryptjs body-parser cors dotenv express express-fileupload http-status-codes jsonwebtoken mongoose nodemailer nodemailer-smtp-transport nanoid` to install basic packages. - Create `.env` file from `.env.example` file and add your environment variables. - Run command `yarn seed` to seed the database. - Run command `yarn dev` to start the development server or `yarn start` to start the production server.
author: Hamza
